headline: Zuckerberg says Meta's enterprise AI opportunity extends beyond agents
snapshot: On the company's second-quarter earnings call Wednesday, CEO Mark Zuckerberg said Meta sees a "large enterprise opportunity" spanning AI agents, APIs, compute, and internal software. The competitive question is whether this changes the model race, enterprise integrations or customer lock-in as major AI providers battle for durable platform advantage.
